questions: Should the generator yield exactly pairs_count tuples, or should it be infinite (yielding pairs_count is just for initialization)?
If range_start > range_end, should the function swap them, raise an error, or treat as empty range?
Is the square root of the absolute difference required to be a float, or can it be an integer if the difference is a perfect square?
Should the random seed be set only once at the start, or should it be reset per call in a way that affects other random calls outside the function?
If random_seed is None, should the random number generator be left unseeded (using system state) or should it default to a specific seed?
Are the two random numbers in each tuple allowed to be the same (leading to sqrt(0)=0)?
Should the generator produce tuples in a fixed order based on the seed, or can it yield in any order as long as numbers are random?
If pairs_count is zero or negative, should the generator be empty, raise an error, or behave differently?
